scale.basis: National Insurance Corporation Act Cap. 16.01 Schedule 3 para. 1: remuneration 'in excess of $60,000 per annum' exempted from contributions (the contribution ceiling). A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Cap. 15.02)' confirmed: personal allowance 25,000 from 1 January 2023 (Schedule 6); 15 % to 15,000, 20 % to 30,000, 30 % above (Schedule 5, 2023 row); NIC 5 % to 60,000 a year, deductible with life premiums up to the lower of 10 % of assessable income or 8,000.
